hooks.prompt: If $USER_PROMPT touches onboarding, /join, /onboarding, /dashboard/setup, activate-workspace, finalize-workspace, onboarding_completed, intelligence ownership, or cascade bootstrap, add a concise systemMessage reminding Claude of these control gates: /join is provisional intake; /onboarding owns bootstrap and finalization; /dashboard/setup is post-bootstrap completion only; onboarding_completed is not the setup-guide visibility switch; intelligence layers must not create parallel onboarding truth beside cascade. Return continue=true.

Review $TOOL_INPUT. If this tool action touches onboarding code, onboarding docs, join flow, dashboard setup flow, steward prompts, or activate/finalize workspace paths, deny any action that would: 1) reintroduce /create-workspace as the active route, 2) treat /join as runtime truth, 3) treat /dashboard/setup as the creator of runtime truth, 4) use workspace.onboarding_completed as the generic setup-guide switch, or 5) add new canonical onboarding dependence on activate-workspace or activate_workspace_v3 instead of shell plus /onboarding finalization. Otherwise allow. Return hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision and a short systemMessage.

Before approving stop, if the session changed onboarding, join, dashboard/setup, activate/finalize workspace, agent guard rails, or hook config, verify the final state still enforces: /join provisional intake only, /onboarding bootstrap/finalization owner, /dashboard/setup post-bootstrap only, onboarding_completed not the guide switch, and no parallel onboarding truth beside cascade. Approve only if aligned; otherwise block with the missing condition.
